content: Could you suggest a hiking trail near Denver, Colorado that is suitable for beginners?

The Bear Creek Trail in Lair O' the Bear Park may be a good option for beginners in Denver. It is a 3.5-mile trail that is relatively easy and has great views. It follows the Bear Creek and there are several picnic areas along the way as well.
Do I need to pay for parking at Lair O' the Bear Park?

Yes, there is a fee for parking at Lair O' the Bear Park. The cost is $10 per vehicle per day. However, if you have an annual Colorado State Park Pass, you can use that to park for free. There is also limited street parking available, but be sure to check the signs for any parking restrictions.
Thanks for the info, I'll definitely check out the Bear Creek Trail. Do you know if there are restrooms along the trail?

Yes, there are restrooms available at the trailhead of the Bear Creek Trail in Lair O' the Bear Park. Additionally, there are also picnic tables, grills, and other amenities at the park that visitors can use.
Is there anywhere nearby where I can grab a bite to eat after my hike?

Yes, there are several dining options near Lair O' the Bear Park where you can get a bite to eat after your hike. One popular spot is Morrison Inn, which serves Mexican cuisine and has a great patio with views of the Red Rocks amphitheater. There is also The Cow Eatery, a casual American restaurant with outdoor seating and a dog-friendly atmosphere. Another option is Tony Rigatoni's Italian Kitchen, which serves classic Italian dishes such as pasta and pizza. All of these restaurants are located in the nearby town of Morrison, about 10 minutes from the park.
The Morrison Inn sounds like a great spot for some post-hike grub. Do they offer vegetarian options?

Yes, Morrison Inn does offer vegetarian options on their menu. They have a separate vegetarian menu with items such as black bean quesadillas, vegetarian enchiladas, and veggie tacos. Additionally, many of their salads and appetizers can also be made vegetarian upon request.
Awesome, I'm definitely going to check out Morrison Inn after my hike.
Enjoy your hike and your meal at Morrison Inn!
